title: Intern-S1: A Scientific Multimodal Foundation Model
paper_type_zh: 前沿模型技术报告与数据披露账本
best_for_zh: 审计持续预训练、RL 任务和奖励披露边界的读者
one_line: Intern-S1 reports 5T continual-pretraining tokens, best-of-N instruction curation, and 8-rollout online RL across more than 1,000 Internbootcamp tasks using CompassVerifier, rules, environment feedback, and POLAR-7B; weights are open, but training records and the full reward stack are not.
Intern-S1 报告了 5T 持续预训练 token（其中超过 2.5T 为科学 token），以及 InternBootCamp 中从离线到在线的 RL 与覆盖超过 1,000 个任务的 Mixture-of-Rewards；任务、数据和奖励细节仍为 unknown。
why: It lets the frontier-disclosure track inspect how scientific sources, instruction records, synthetic tasks, verifiers, and open-ended rewards are combined, while keeping the boundary between a released checkpoint and an unreleased training pipeline explicit.
inclusion_reason: A frontier model report with unusually concrete disclosure of scientific-data mining, instruction curation, Internbootcamp task generation, verifier/reward routing, and online RL settings, while leaving the underlying records and essential audit artifacts unreleased.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Intern-S1 addresses a specific scaling problem: scientific reasoning must cover low-resource modalities and specialized domains without building a separate expert pipeline for every task. For this atlas, the relevant question is not whether the resulting model leads a benchmark table. It is whether the report exposes the training records, construction decisions, and feedback contracts well enough to audit how scientific capability was produced.

The report spans three data-bearing layers. Continual pretraining uses 5T text tokens, including more than 2.5T scientific tokens, plus a later image-text stage of about 250B tokens. The offline post-training stage selects best-of-N responses from curated text and multimodal instructions. The online stage uses more than 1,000 Internbootcamp task types and heterogeneous rewards. These layers are described in meaningful detail, but their records, complete source manifests, and reward implementations are not released.

Intern-S1 处理的是一个具体的规模化问题：科学推理既要覆盖低资源模态与专业领域，又不能为每项任务分别搭建一套专家流水线。对本图谱而言，关键不在于模型是否位居基准榜单前列，而在于报告是否充分披露训练记录、构造决策和反馈合同，使读者能够审计科学能力是如何形成的。

报告涉及三层带数据的流程。持续预训练使用 5T 文本 token，其中超过 2.5T 为科学 token，随后还有约 250B token 的图文阶段；离线后训练从经过整理的文本与多模态指令中选择 best-of-N 响应；在线阶段则使用 1,000 多种 Internbootcamp 任务和异构奖励。这些层面的机制披露较具体，但记录本身、完整来源清单与奖励实现均未发布。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The report couples two construction systems. For pretraining, page-level PDF parsing routes most pages through MinerU and sends equation- or symbol-heavy pages to higher-cost VLM parsers; a domain-centric web pipeline uses LLM agents to discard, rewrite, or retain groups of pages; and scientific recall uses strong-LLM silver labels to train cheaper fastText or 1.5B classifiers. This produces a science-heavy CPT mixture rather than a named reusable dataset.

For post-training, the authors call best-of-N instruction tuning "offline reinforcement learning" because every retained response has already passed criteria such as accuracy, fluency, or safety. Online RL then uses Mixture-of-Rewards to map different task feedback into one scalar: verifiable tasks can use CompassVerifier, rules, or environmental feedback, while open-ended dialogue uses POLAR-7B. The resulting object is a prompt-response or multimodal trajectory with scalar reward, sometimes accompanied by binary correctness.

The classification is therefore mixed-verification SFT and RLVR inside a frontier pipeline. The release supplies model weights and inference tooling, not the training corpus, complete Internbootcamp task collection, or a replayable reward layer.

报告把两套构造系统连接起来。预训练侧采用 page-level PDF parsing：多数页面先由 MinerU 处理，含较多公式或符号的页面再路由给成本更高的 VLM parser；domain-centric web pipeline 让 LLM agent 按站点域名决定丢弃、改写或保留页面；scientific recall 则用强 LLM 生成 silver label，再训练成本较低的 fastText 或 1.5B classifier。其产物是科学数据占比较高的 CPT 混合，而不是一个具名、可复用的数据集。

后训练侧把 best-of-N 指令微调称为“offline reinforcement learning”，理由是保留的响应已经按准确性、流畅性或安全性等奖励标准筛过。在线 RL 随后通过 Mixture-of-Rewards 把不同任务的反馈映射为统一标量：可验证任务可以使用 CompassVerifier、规则或环境反馈，开放式对话则使用 POLAR-7B。最终数据对象是带标量奖励的文本或多模态 prompt-response 轨迹，部分样本还带二元正确性信号。

因此，这项工作应归为前沿流水线中的混合验证 SFT 与 RLVR。官方发布提供模型权重和推理工具，却没有开放训练语料、完整 Internbootcamp 任务集或可回放奖励层。

title: Method
方法
html:
Scientific CPT draws from archived and web PDFs, open pretraining corpora, Common Crawl, InternVL3 multimodal data, and scientific multimodal sources. PDF pages undergo hybrid OCR/VLM parsing, parser-specific cleanup, garble detection, and page-level graph deduplication. The report says about 20% of archived-library tokens are removed; web PDFs retain about 50% after additional education-level scoring. Domain-level LLM agents inspect sampled pages from a URL domain and choose discard, rewrite, or retain actions. A separate taxonomy covers mathematics, physics, chemistry, life science, earth science, and materials science; strong-LLM labels train lightweight classifiers, and manual evaluation reports target-domain purity rising from about 2% to 50%.

Offline instruction curation filters repetitive, truncated, or hallucinated records, labels category and difficulty, stratifies sampling, and reconstructs or synthesizes underrepresented areas. Ground-truth items receive difficulty estimates from small-model rollout pass rates. Vision-language instruction data begins from InternVL3 and extends SOPHIA with rejection sampling, deduplication, length/format constraints, self-consistency, and programmatic verification when available. Best-of-N produces each retained response, but N, generator identities, sampling settings, thresholds, record counts, and final mixture ratios are unknown.

Online RL combines several sources. Internbootcamp covers more than 1,000 procedurally generated task types; the report says its generator makes more than 100,000 candidates per task and heuristic downsampling leaves more than 20,000 samples for mixed RL. Instruction-following prompts are selected at passrate@64 in [0.2, 0.8]. Math sources include OREAL-RL-Prompts, DAPO-Math-17k, Skywork-OR1-RL-Data, and internal problems. Multimodal sources include MMPR, MMK12, and private collections; some text questions are rendered as images and some multiple-choice questions are converted to fill-in-the-blank form. Open-ended prompts come mainly from UltraFeedback, HH-RLHF, and anonymized user queries, with reference trajectories from randomly selected unnamed SOTA LLMs.

Mixture-of-Rewards routes ground-truth tasks through CompassVerifier, rules, or environment feedback and routes open-ended dialogue through POLAR-7B. Hybrid filtering uses 8 rollouts: it removes overly easy/noisy items offline, all-correct or all-wrong groups online, and garbled or infinitely repetitive outputs. Training adapts OREAL without its token-level reward model, adds KL-Cov entropy control, generates 8 responses per prompt, uses batch size 4096 for 600 steps with AdamW at 5e-7, freezes the ViT and MoE router, drops about 3% of high-gradient-norm samples, and averages selected checkpoints.

科学 CPT 的来源包括归档与网页 PDF、开放预训练语料、Common Crawl、InternVL3 多模态数据和科学多模态来源。PDF 页面经过混合 OCR/VLM 解析、针对不同 parser 的清洗、乱码检测和 page-level graph deduplication。报告称归档库 token 约有 20% 被移除；网页 PDF 再经过 education-level scorer 后约保留 50%。domain-level LLM agent 会查看同一 URL domain 的抽样页面，并决定整组丢弃、改写或保留。另一套 taxonomy 覆盖数学、物理、化学、生命科学、地球科学和材料科学；强 LLM 标注用于训练轻量 classifier，人工评估称目标领域纯度由约 2% 提升到 50%。

离线指令整理会过滤重复、截断或幻觉记录，标注类别与难度，进行分层抽样，并对样本不足的领域重写响应或补充合成数据。带 ground truth 的样本使用小模型多次 rollout 的通过率估计难度。视觉语言指令数据以 InternVL3 为起点，并用拒绝采样、去重、长度/格式约束、自一致性和可用时的程序验证扩展 SOPHIA。每个保留响应来自 best-of-N，但 N、生成器身份、采样设置、阈值、记录数量和最终混合比例均为 unknown。

在线 RL 组合多类来源。Internbootcamp 覆盖 1,000 多种程序生成任务；报告称每项任务由 generator 构造 100,000 多个候选，再经启发式下采样，最终有 20,000 多个样本用于混合 RL。instruction-following prompt 按 passrate@64 位于 [0.2, 0.8] 的条件筛选。数学来源包括 OREAL-RL-Prompts、DAPO-Math-17k、Skywork-OR1-RL-Data 和内部题目；多模态来源包括 MMPR、MMK12 与 private collections，部分文本题被渲染为图像，部分选择题被改写为填空题。开放式 prompt 主要来自 UltraFeedback、HH-RLHF 和匿名真实用户查询，reference trajectory 则由未具名 SOTA LLM 池中随机选择的模型生成。

Mixture-of-Rewards 让带 ground truth 的任务使用 CompassVerifier、规则或环境反馈，让开放式对话使用 POLAR-7B。混合过滤以 8 次 rollout 为一组：离线删除过易或可能带噪的问题，在线删除全对或全错组，并移除乱码和无限重复输出。训练采用去掉 token-level reward model 的 OREAL 变体，加入 KL-Cov 熵控制；每个 prompt 生成 8 个响应，以 batch size 4096 训练 600 step，AdamW 学习率为 5e-7；ViT 与 MoE router 冻结，约 3% 的高 gradient-norm 样本被丢弃，最后对选中 checkpoint 做权重平均。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The official arXiv v2 paper supports the disclosed CPT volumes, PDF/web construction pipelines, instruction filtering and labeling, Internbootcamp task generation, Mixture-of-Rewards routing, 8-rollout filtering, and optimizer settings. It also reports ablations or training curves for domain recall, hybrid RL filtering, and entropy control, plus evaluations across general and scientific benchmarks. Those experiments demonstrate behavior under the authors' protocols; they do not establish that the underlying records are accurate, uncontaminated, legally reusable, or released.

The official Intern-S1 repository and Hugging Face model card verify release of Intern-S1 weights, configuration and inference examples under Apache-2.0. They also identify the Qwen3 235B MoE and InternViT-6B starting components. The repository says training infrastructure will be released through XTuner, but the checked release does not expose the 5T-token corpus, offline instruction records, Internbootcamp's full task/sample inventory, online trajectories, Mixture-of-Rewards implementation, or complete verifier mapping.

The strongest supported conclusion is therefore asymmetric: the model artifact is reusable for inference, while the data and feedback pipeline is only documented at recipe level. Benchmark performance cannot close that audit gap.

官方 arXiv v2 论文支持所披露的 CPT 规模、PDF/网页构造流水线、指令过滤与标注、Internbootcamp 任务生成、Mixture-of-Rewards 路由、8-rollout 过滤和优化设置。论文还报告了 domain recall、混合 RL 过滤和熵控制的消融或训练曲线，以及通用与科学基准评测。这些实验说明模型在作者协议下的行为，却不能证明底层记录准确、无污染、可合法复用或已经发布。

官方 Intern-S1 仓库与 Hugging Face 模型卡确认 Intern-S1 权重、配置和推理示例以 Apache-2.0 发布，并确认其起始组件为 Qwen3 235B MoE 与 InternViT-6B。报告称训练基础设施将通过 XTuner 发布，但已核查的发布中没有 5T-token 语料、离线指令记录、Internbootcamp 完整任务/样本清单、在线轨迹、Mixture-of-Rewards 实现或完整 verifier 映射。

因此，证据支持的是一个不对称结论：模型产物可用于推理复用，数据与反馈流水线则只达到 recipe 级披露。基准性能不能弥补这一审计缺口。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The useful contribution for data curation is the end-to-end linkage between source mining, instruction selection, generated tasks, and reward routing. The report does not stop at saying that scientific data and RL were used: it describes page-level parser escalation, domain-level agent decisions, classifier distillation from strong-LLM labels, category/difficulty stratification, best-of-N response selection, pass-rate filtering, and the mapping of task classes to CompassVerifier, rules, environment feedback, or POLAR-7B.

At the optimizer layer, it also documents a concrete MoE failure boundary. The authors report that token-level importance-ratio clipping is unreliable when FP8 inference and training activate different experts, so their OREAL variant removes the token-level reward model and adds KL-Cov entropy control. This connects data filtering and reward granularity to the stability of the training system rather than treating them as interchangeable implementation details.

The ingredients are not all new: Intern-S1 starts from Qwen3 and InternViT, reuses InternVL3/SOPHIA data pipelines and several public RL datasets, and relies on existing CompassVerifier and POLAR-7B components. The direction signal is their integration across scientific CPT, offline instruction selection, and more-than-1,000-task online RL—not a claim that the training data itself is open or independently validated.

对数据策展而言，有用的贡献是把来源挖掘、指令筛选、任务生成和奖励路由连成一条端到端链路。报告不只声称使用了科学数据与 RL，还具体描述了 page-level parser 升级、domain-level agent 决策、由强 LLM 标签蒸馏 classifier、类别/难度分层、best-of-N 响应选择、通过率过滤，以及不同任务类别到 CompassVerifier、规则、环境反馈或 POLAR-7B 的映射。

在优化器层，报告还记录了一个具体的 MoE 失效边界。作者称，当 FP8 推理与训练激活不同专家时，token-level importance-ratio clipping 不可靠，因此其 OREAL 变体去掉 token-level reward model，并加入 KL-Cov 熵控制。这使数据过滤与奖励粒度直接关联到训练系统稳定性，而不是被当成可互换的实现细节。

这些组成并非全部新颖：Intern-S1 从 Qwen3 与 InternViT 出发，复用 InternVL3/SOPHIA 数据管线和多个公开 RL 数据集，也依赖已有的 CompassVerifier 与 POLAR-7B。真正的方向信号是它们在科学 CPT、离线指令筛选和 1,000 多任务在线 RL 中的整合，而不是训练数据已经开放或获得独立验证。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The CPT disclosure remains aggregate. The report does not publish a source manifest, per-source token counts, domain mixture weights, collection dates, page or document lineage, parser decisions, licenses, or retained/rejected records. It names private multimodal collections and anonymized user queries without disclosing governance, consent, or redistribution terms. Page-level deduplication is reported, but benchmark overlap and source-level contamination are not audited publicly.

Offline post-training omits the best-of-N value, response-generator identities, decoding parameters, score thresholds, exact record counts, and final mixture. Online RL reports more than 1,000 tasks, more than 100,000 generated candidates per task, and more than 20,000 retained mixed-RL samples, but supplies no task/sample inventory or mapping between tasks and verifiers. The apparent compression from candidates to retained records therefore cannot be independently reconstructed.

The reward layer is only partly auditable. CompassVerifier is intended to reduce rule-verifier false negatives, but no Intern-S1-specific calibration or false-positive/false-negative analysis is provided. Mixture-of-Rewards does not disclose per-task weights or scalar normalization. POLAR-7B, randomly selected reference-trajectory generators, and environmental feedback add learned or opaque dependencies. Hybrid filtering removes all-correct/all-wrong groups and problematic responses, but rejected samples are unavailable for bias analysis.

The released weights and Apache-2.0 repository make inference possible, not training reproduction. Complete Internbootcamp environments, training data, reward code, source rights, split manifests, and decontamination evidence remain unknown. Reported benchmark gains should not be read as proof of data quality.

CPT 披露仍停留在聚合层面。报告没有发布来源清单、各来源 token 数、领域混合权重、采集日期、页面或文档谱系、parser 决策、许可信息，也没有保留/拒绝记录。它提到 private multimodal collections 与匿名真实用户查询，却未说明治理、同意或再分发条款。论文报告了 page-level deduplication，但没有公开审计基准重叠或来源级污染。

离线后训练没有给出 best-of-N 的 N、响应生成器身份、解码参数、评分阈值、准确记录数或最终混合比例。在线 RL 报告 1,000 多项任务、每项任务生成 100,000 多个候选，并最终保留 20,000 多个混合 RL 样本，却没有任务/样本清单或任务到 verifier 的映射。因此，候选到保留记录的大幅压缩无法独立重建。

奖励层只能部分审计。CompassVerifier 旨在减少规则 verifier 的 false negative，但没有 Intern-S1 专属校准或 false-positive/false-negative 分析；Mixture-of-Rewards 也没有披露各任务权重或标量归一化。POLAR-7B、随机选择的 reference-trajectory generator 和环境反馈又引入学习式或不透明依赖。混合过滤会删除全对/全错组和问题响应，但被拒样本未开放，无法分析筛选偏差。

已发布权重和 Apache-2.0 仓库支持推理，不等于训练可复现。完整 Internbootcamp 环境、训练数据、奖励代码、来源权利、split manifest 和去污染证据仍为 unknown。论文报告的基准提升不应被视为数据质量证明。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Within the frontier reports and data-disclosure ledger track, Intern-S1 is a detailed comparison case for scientific multimodal pipelines. It supports a structured audit: Which sources feed CPT? Which parsers or classifiers transform them? What is one offline instruction record? How is difficulty estimated? Which tasks are procedurally generated? Which reward component judges each task? Which records, environments, and verifier implementations are actually released?

The Card supports precise downstream labels. Intern-S1 uses demonstration-style SFT under the paper's "offline RL" terminology and mixed-verification online RLVR. Easy-to-verify tasks can receive CompassVerifier, rule, or environment rewards; open-ended dialogue receives POLAR-7B. The model weights are open, but the training records, complete task inventory, reward routing, and replayable environments are not. Builders can study the recipe and run the checkpoint, but cannot reconstruct the data pipeline from the checked artifacts.

The most reusable lesson is to separate recipe disclosure from artifact disclosure. Concrete counts, filters, and optimizer settings improve auditability, yet they do not make the source mixture, selected records, or verifier errors observable. That distinction is central to comparing frontier reports without turning benchmark results into claims about data quality.

在“前沿报告与数据披露账本”轨道中，Intern-S1 是比较科学多模态流水线的一个细节较丰富的案例。它支持结构化审计：哪些来源进入 CPT？哪些 parser 或 classifier 改写它们？一条离线指令记录是什么？难度如何估计？哪些任务由程序生成？每类任务由哪种奖励判断？哪些记录、环境与 verifier 实现真正发布？

本 Card 支持精确的下游标签。Intern-S1 使用论文称为“offline RL”的 demonstration-style SFT，并进行混合验证的在线 RLVR。易验证任务可以接收 CompassVerifier、规则或环境奖励，开放式对话则接收 POLAR-7B。模型权重已开放，但训练记录、完整任务清单、奖励路由和可回放环境没有开放。使用者可以研究 recipe 并运行 checkpoint，却不能从已核查产物重建数据流水线。

最可复用的经验是区分 recipe disclosure 与 artifact disclosure。具体计数、过滤规则和优化设置确实提高可审计性，但不会自动让来源混合、被选记录或 verifier 误差变得可观察。要在不把基准结果误写成数据质量结论的前提下比较前沿报告，这一区分至关重要。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read Sections 4.1 and 4.2 of the paper HTML together: the 5T/2.5T aggregates sit above page-level PDF parsing, domain-centric web decisions, scientific recall classifiers, and a separate 250B image-text stage.
  • In Section 5.1, translate "offline RL" into its concrete object: best-of-N-selected instruction responses trained with a conventional SFT objective; the generators, N, thresholds, record counts, and final mixture remain unknown.
  • In Sections 5.2.1 and 5.2.2, trace reward routing by task: Internbootcamp verifiers, passrate@64 instruction filtering, CompassVerifier plus rules for multimodal correctness, and POLAR-7B for open-ended dialogue.
  • Check Sections 5.2.3 and 5.2.4 for 8-rollout filtering, the OREAL/KL-Cov objective, frozen ViT/router, 600 steps, and the removal of about 3% of high-gradient-norm samples.
  • Compare the repository and model card with the paper: they verify weights and inference tooling, not release of the 5T corpus, instruction/RL records, task inventory, or full reward stack.

• 把论文 HTML 的 4.1 与 4.2 节连起来读：5T/2.5T 聚合数字之下还有 page-level PDF parsing、domain-centric web 决策、科学数据召回 classifier，以及单独的 250B 图文阶段。
  • 阅读 5.1 节时，应把“offline RL”还原成具体对象：由 best-of-N 筛选出的指令响应，再用常规 SFT 目标训练；生成器、N、阈值、记录数和最终混合仍为 unknown。
  • 在 5.2.1 与 5.2.2 节按任务追踪奖励路由：Internbootcamp verifier、passrate@64 指令筛选、用于多模态正确性的 CompassVerifier 加规则，以及用于开放式对话的 POLAR-7B。
  • 核对 5.2.3 与 5.2.4 节中的 8-rollout 过滤、OREAL/KL-Cov 目标、冻结 ViT/router、600 step，以及约 3% 高 gradient-norm 样本被删除的设置。
  • 对照官方仓库与模型卡：它们确认权重和推理工具已发布，并不代表 5T 语料、指令/RL 记录、任务清单或完整奖励栈已经开放。

value.html: Offline instruction data spans agent, code, dialogue, instruction following, mathematics, reasoning, long text, safety, chemistry, life science, and physics; the vision-language portion inherits InternVL3 data and extends SOPHIA. Online RL uses InternBootcamp synthetic tasks, open math and multimodal datasets, internal university/competition problems, private multimodal collections, UltraFeedback, HH-RLHF, and anonymized user queries. Complete source inventories and mixture counts are unknown.

value_zh.html: 离线指令数据覆盖智能体、代码、对话、指令遵循、数学、推理、长文本、安全、化学、生命科学与物理；视觉-语言部分继承 InternVL3 数据并扩展 SOPHIA。在线 RL 使用 InternBootcamp 合成任务、公开数学与多模态数据集、内部大学/竞赛题目、私有多模态集合、UltraFeedback、HH-RLHF 与匿名化用户查询。完整来源清单与混合计数未知。

value.html: Text or multimodal prompt-response records for offline training, followed by online prompt-response trajectories carrying a unified scalar reward. Verifiable tasks can also carry binary correctness from CompassVerifier, rules, or environmental feedback; open-ended dialogue receives a POLAR-7B scalar.

value_zh.html: 用于离线训练的文本或多模态提示-响应记录，随后是携带统一标量奖励的在线提示-响应轨迹。可核验任务还可携带来自 CompassVerifier、规则或环境反馈的二元正确性；开放式对话接收 POLAR-7B 标量。

value.html: Offline responses are selected by best-of-N sampling, but the response generators and N are undisclosed. Online trajectories are generated by the current Intern-S1 policy. For open-ended preference RL, reference trajectories are produced by randomly selected unnamed SOTA LLMs from an undisclosed open/closed model pool.

value_zh.html: 离线响应用 best-of-N 采样选择，但响应生成器与 N 未披露。在线轨迹由当前 Intern-S1 策略生成。对开放式偏好 RL，参考轨迹由从未披露的开源/闭源模型池中随机选择的未具名 SOTA LLM 产生。

value.html: InternBootcamp supplies more than 1,000 procedurally generated tasks across algorithms, character reasoning, cryptography, graphical puzzles, board games, logic, physics equations, chemistry formulas, and medical reasoning; full task implementations and a replayable training environment were not found in the checked Intern-S1 release.

value_zh.html: InternBootcamp 提供超过 1,000 个程序生成任务，覆盖算法、角色推理、密码学、图形谜题、棋盘游戏、逻辑、物理方程、化学公式与医学推理；在所核验的 Intern-S1 发布中未找到完整任务实现与可回放训练环境。

value.html: Mixture-of-Rewards maps heterogeneous feedback to a scalar. InternBootcamp tasks use verifiable rewards; instruction-following prompts are difficulty-filtered with passrate@64; multimodal reasoning uses CompassVerifier plus rules for binary correctness; open-ended dialogue uses POLAR-7B. The mixture weights, per-task verifier mapping, calibration, and error rates are unknown.

value_zh.html: Mixture-of-Rewards 将异构反馈映射为标量。InternBootcamp 任务使用可核验奖励；指令遵循提示用 passrate@64 做难度过滤；多模态推理用 CompassVerifier 加规则得到二元正确性；开放式对话使用 POLAR-7B。混合权重、逐任务验证器映射、校准与错误率未知。

value.html: For tasks with ground truth, acceptance is answer correctness under CompassVerifier, rules, or environment feedback. Open-ended tasks have no disclosed executable terminal predicate and instead use POLAR-7B reward.

value_zh.html: 对有真值的任务，接受条件为 CompassVerifier、规则或环境反馈下的答案正确性。开放式任务未披露可执行终态谓词，转而使用 POLAR-7B 奖励。

value.html: Qwen3-235B-A22B with InternViT-6B; the paper describes 241B total and 28B activated parameters after adding multimodal components.

value_zh.html: Qwen3-235B-A22B 配 InternViT-6B；论文称加入多模态组件后共 241B 参数、激活 28B。

value.html: unknown; the paper names Qwen2.5 and other VLM/LLM tools for selected parsing, completeness, labeling, and filtering operations but does not identify the offline best-of-N response generator or all judge versions.

value_zh.html: 未知；论文点名 Qwen2.5 及其他 VLM/LLM 工具用于选定的解析、完整性、标注与过滤操作，但未指明离线 best-of-N 响应生成器或全部评审模型版本。

value.html: Scientific CPT data comes from archived/web PDFs, open pretraining corpora, Common Crawl, InternVL3 multimodal data, and scientific multimodal sources. Page-level hybrid parsing uses MinerU first and routes equation/symbol-heavy pages to VLM parsers. Domain-level LLM agents choose discard, rewrite, or retain actions. Offline instruction responses use best-of-N generation; InternBootcamp case generators and the online policy create RL records.

value_zh.html: 科学 CPT 数据来自归档/网页 PDF、公开预训练语料、Common Crawl、InternVL3 多模态数据与科学多模态来源。页级混合解析先用 MinerU，并将方程/符号密集页路由到 VLM 解析器。领域级 LLM 智能体选择丢弃、改写或保留动作。离线指令响应用 best-of-N 生成；InternBootcamp 案例生成器与在线策略创建 RL 记录。

value.html: CPT reports 5T text tokens with more than 2.5T scientific tokens; the image-text stage reports about 250B tokens, including 30B scientific tokens. Offline training selects best-of-N responses and tunes domain mixtures by atomic and compositional benchmark ablations. Internbootcamp generates more than 100,000 candidates per task and heuristically downsamples to more than 20,000 mixed-RL samples. Online RL generates 8 responses per prompt, uses batch size 4096, and trains for 600 steps.

value_zh.html: CPT 报告 5T 文本 tokens，其中科学 tokens 超过 2.5T；图文阶段报告约 250B tokens，含 30B 科学 tokens。离线训练选择 best-of-N 响应，并通过原子与组合基准消融调整领域混合。Internbootcamp 每个任务生成超过 100,000 个候选，并启发式下采样到超过 20,000 条混合 RL 样本。在线 RL 每个提示生成 8 条响应，batch size 为 4096，训练 600 步。

value.html: PDF pages undergo garble detection, page-level graph deduplication, parser-specific cleanup, and education-level scoring; about 20% of archived-library tokens are removed and about 50% of web-PDF tokens are retained. Scientific web data uses LLM labels distilled into fastText or 1.5B classifiers. Instruction data is filtered for repetition, truncation, hallucination, category, and difficulty, then stratified. Online RL applies domain-level mixing plus offline/online pass-rate filtering and removes all-correct/all-wrong rollout groups, garbled responses, infinite repetition, and high-gradient-norm batches.

value_zh.html: PDF 页经过乱码检测、页级图去重、解析器特定清理与教育级别打分；约 20% 的归档库 tokens 被移除，约 50% 的网页 PDF tokens 被保留。科学网页数据使用蒸馏到 fastText 或 1.5B 分类器的 LLM 标签。指令数据按重复、截断、幻觉、类别与难度过滤，然后分层。在线 RL 应用领域级混合以及离线/在线通过率过滤，并移除全对/全错 rollout 组、乱码响应、无限重复与高梯度范数批次。

value.html: Training generation limits are unknown. The reported evaluation uses max_tokens 65,536, temperature 0.7, top_p 0.95, and top_k 50 for Intern-S1.

value_zh.html: 训练生成限制未知。所报告评测对 Intern-S1 使用 max_tokens 65,536、temperature 0.7、top_p 0.95 与 top_k 50。

value.html: Four training stages culminate in offline then online post-training. The offline stage is conventional SFT over rewarded best-of-N responses. Online training adapts OREAL by removing its token-level reward model, combines SFT loss on positive samples with policy-gradient loss on negatives, and adds KL-Cov entropy control. It uses AdamW at 5e-7 with weight decay 0.1, freezes the ViT encoder and MoE router, drops about 3% of samples with a gradient-norm filter, and averages selected checkpoints.

value_zh.html: 四个训练阶段最终为离线然后在线后训练。离线阶段是对带奖励的 best-of-N 响应做常规 SFT。在线训练通过移除 token 级奖励模型来改造 OREAL，将正样本上的 SFT loss 与负样本上的策略梯度 loss 结合，并加入 KL-Cov 熵控制。使用 AdamW，5e-7，weight decay 0.1，冻结 ViT 编码器与 MoE 路由器，用梯度范数过滤器丢弃约 3% 样本，并对所选 checkpoints 取平均。

value.html: The report gives aggregate CPT volumes, six scientific domains, named public components, private collections, and anonymized user-query sources, but not a complete item inventory, per-source counts, mixture weights, collection dates, source URLs, licenses, or record-level provenance.

value_zh.html: 报告给出合计 CPT 体量、六个科学领域、具名公开组件、私有集合与匿名化用户查询来源，但未给出完整条目清单、逐来源计数、混合权重、采集日期、来源 URL、许可或记录级出处。

value.html: Offline instruction data, online RL data, and evaluation benchmarks are described separately, but no released split manifests or item-level mappings were found.

value_zh.html: 离线指令数据、在线 RL 数据与评测基准被分开描述，但未找到已发布的划分清单或条目级映射。

value.html: The pipeline performs page-level deduplication and data filtering, but the checked report and release do not provide a benchmark-overlap audit, source-level decontamination results, or memorization analysis.

value_zh.html: 流水线执行页级去重与数据过滤，但所核验的报告与发布未提供基准重叠审计、来源级去污染结果或记忆分析。

items: Mixture-of-Rewards combines heterogeneous reward scales without publishing mixture weights, per-task mappings, calibration, or cross-task error analysis.
CompassVerifier is intended to reduce rule-verifier false negatives, but its false-positive and false-negative rates on Intern-S1 training tasks are not reported.
Online filtering deliberately removes all-correct and all-wrong rollout groups, which changes the training distribution; retained and rejected records are not released for audit.
Private multimodal collections and anonymized user queries lack disclosed governance, consent, provenance, and license details.
Data-mixture choices are tuned against benchmark performance, but no complete contamination or test-overlap audit is disclosed.
Reported benchmark gains measure model behavior under the stated protocol and do not establish accuracy, legality, representativeness, or reusability of the unreleased training data.
Mixture-of-Rewards 组合异构奖励尺度，但未公布混合权重、逐任务映射、校准或跨任务误差分析。
CompassVerifier 旨在减少规则验证器的假阴性，但未报告其在 Intern-S1 训练任务上的假阳性与假阴性率。
在线过滤有意移除全对与全错 rollout 组，这会改变训练分布；保留与拒绝的记录未发布供审计。
私有多模态集合与匿名化用户查询缺少已披露的治理、同意、出处与许可细节。
数据混合选择按基准表现调优，但未披露完整污染或测试重叠审计。
所报告的基准增益衡量所述协议下的模型行为，并不确立未发布训练数据的准确性、合法性、代表性或可复用性。

value.html: The official GitHub repository and released Intern-S1 weights are Apache-2.0. Rights and redistribution terms for the 5T-token mixture, archived/web PDFs, private collections, anonymized user queries, and generated training records are unknown.

value_zh.html: 官方 GitHub 仓库与已发布 Intern-S1 权重为 Apache-2.0。5T-token 混合物、归档/网页 PDF、私有集合、匿名化用户查询与生成训练记录的权利与再分发条款未知。

value.html: The report identifies Qwen3-235B-A22B, InternViT-6B, four broad training stages, and many source classes and transformations. It does not release item-level source-to-record lineage, exact generator/judge versions, stage manifests, or training data.

value_zh.html: 报告指明 Qwen3-235B-A22B、InternViT-6B、四个宽泛训练阶段，以及许多来源类别与变换。未发布条目级来源到记录谱系、精确生成器/评审模型版本、阶段清单或训练数据。
